tools.name: list_events
tools.description: Use to find cards. Lists events newest first with the venue, status, number of fights and main event. Filter by season (year) and status (scheduled or final). Costs 1 credit.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Use for one card: every fight in order with the result, method, round and time, judges' scores and referee. Costs 2 credits.

tools.name: get_schedule
tools.description: Use for upcoming fights: every scheduled bout in the next N days (default 30) with the current moneyline from any book that has posted one. Costs 2 credits.

tools.name: get_fight
tools.description: Use for everything about one fight: the result, both fighters' full stat sheets (strikes by target and position, takedowns, control time, guard passes, reversals, submission attempts; UFC only, null elsewhere and where the source has no sheet), round-by-round lines (UFC only), each fighter's rating

tools.name: search_fighters
tools.description: Use to find a fighter's id by name or nickname (accents optional). Returns weight class, country, pro record, number of fights in the promotion (bouts; ufc_bouts for the UFC only) and last fight date. Costs 1 credit.

tools.name: get_fighter
tools.description: Use for one fighter's profile: date of birth, height, reach, stance, gym, record in the promotion by method (record; ufc_record is the same for the UFC and null for other promotions), career rates per 15 minutes from the stat sheets (significant strikes landed and absorbed, accuracy, defense, takedo

tools.name: get_fighter_fights
tools.description: Use for a fighter's full history in the promotion: every fight with the opponent, result, method, round, time, strikes landed and absorbed and takedowns (UFC only), rating before and after, and the median closing moneyline across sportsbooks. Costs 5 credits.

tools.name: get_leaders
tools.description: Use for career leaderboards computed from every fight's stat sheet: sig_landed_per_15 (significant strikes landed per 15 min), sig_absorbed_per_15 (significant strikes absorbed per 15 min), sig_accuracy (significant strike accuracy), sig_defense (significant strike defense), td_per_15 (takedowns lan

tools.name: get_ratings
tools.description: Use for our fighter ratings: an Elo built from the promotion's own results (the UFC since 2000), highest first, for fighters active since a given year (default last year). Filter by weight class. Costs 2 credits.

tools.name: get_odds
tools.description: Use for betting lines: each posted sportsbook's opening, closing and current moneyline for both fighters, with implied probabilities and the total-rounds line. Opening and closing lines start with the UFC cards of June 2020; a median of 5 to 7 books per fight (ESPN's own feed is one book per fight s

tools.name: get_line_movement
tools.description: Use to see how a fight's line moved before the bell: our snapshots of each posted moneyline, from first capture to fight day (ESPN's once a day from October 2026, The Odds API's every hour in the two days before). Costs 10 credits.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_odds · Private data: search_fighters, get_fighter · Public sink: get_fighter, get_leaders.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_odds · Private data: search_fighters, get_fighter · Public sink: get_fighter, get_leaders

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
